entities.name: Andrés Guibert
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Andrés Guibert Sargenton, commonly known as Andrés Guibert, is a Cuban-Puerto Rican former professional basketball player. In 1993, Guibert defected to Puerto Rico, from the Cuban delegation at the 1993 Central American and Caribbean Games, that was held in Ponce.
